intended_object: The Hopf-algebra (bialgebra) morphism O(B_n) → O(U_n) dual to the closed immersion of the unitriangular group scheme U_n into the upper-triangular group scheme B_n over a commutative ring K. This is the restriction/quotient map on coordinate rings. Inferred from the docstring, the name and the module documentation.
explanation: The underlying K-algebra map comes from the universal property of O(B_n) (via `upperTriangularFromGL`) applied to the universal unitriangular matrix in U(O(U_n)), included into B_n. By Yoneda, this is exactly the comorphism of U_n ↪ B_n. The bialgebra structure is obtained by `bialgHomOfCompQuotient`. This is valid because the composite O(GL_n) → O(B_n) → O(U_n) equals the Hopf quotient O(GL_n) → O(U_n) (lemma `upperTriangularUnitriangularCoordinateMap_comp_quotient`), and O(GL_n) → O(B_n) is surjective. The setting (K any commutative ring, n any finite linearly ordered index type) is the natural one: the order is needed to define upper-triangular matrices. Mathlib has no counterpart for these coordinate rings.
